reviews.fabrication_check: Every count, time and outcome above comes from a command I ran in this session. The runs used a git archive of 0b9fc50 and my own MinIO, infrx-verify-m1l2-minio on 127.0.0.1:55681 (the image digest and E2 literals from tests/integration/compose.yaml). I never used namespace e2, port 55432, AWS or another lane's container. For the no-credentials attacks I pointed the credential files at /dev/null and IMDS at a dead local port, so nothing reached AWS or ~/.aws. The lane's claims reproduce: test_s3 38 (23 + 15 skips without an endpoint), the mutant list 43/43, tests/g quick 509, contracts 1022 + the pre-existing test_cancel_cause failure, tests/i 64. One environmental difference: tests/m gave 380 + 1 skip here, not the lane's 381. The skip is test_parity's missing corpus cache, not an M1-L2 case. On the merge base: origin/codex/cutover-mount still points at 6cb8ebe, which this branch already contains. I therefore merged the local codex/cutover-mount head 351d084, the newer head the task describes, and name it here. The AWS-specific statements (us-east-1 CreateBucket answering 200 on an owned bucket; AWS DeleteObject answering 204 for a missing key) come from S3's documented behaviour. I did not measure them.
